purpose: Machine-readable build shortcuts extracted from Townscaper/Planet-style procedural grid systems.

build_shortcuts.summary: Store terrain truth on shared vertices/corners before cell mesh emission.
build_shortcuts.build_time_value: Avoids per-hex crack debugging and duplicated seam height logic.

build_shortcuts.summary: Use dual triangle-like corner regions to own three-cell corner transitions.
build_shortcuts.build_time_value: Makes corner elevation conflicts explicit and keeps edge rules smaller.

build_shortcuts.summary: Classify terrain by integer height bands before solving continuous heights.
build_shortcuts.build_time_value: Fits 32x32x8 constraints and removes vague slope thresholds from the first proof.

build_shortcuts.summary: Treat height deltas of two or more bands as cliff/ledge/fault profiles by default.
build_shortcuts.build_time_value: Prevents stretched melted slopes and gives simple ledge/cliff criteria.

build_shortcuts.summary: Split terrain into base height, cliff, road, pad, and material layers instead of all combinations.
build_shortcuts.build_time_value: Controls combinatorial explosion and keeps authored/profile variants reusable.

build_shortcuts.summary: Apply smoothing/relaxation only after shared seams are canonical and welded.
build_shortcuts.build_time_value: Avoids local smoothing creating cracks between chunks or cells.

build_shortcuts.summary: Detect bridges, stairs, gates, and pad clusters as macro signatures after simple edge policies work.
build_shortcuts.build_time_value: Keeps the v0 compiler small and avoids burying special cases in edge code.
